steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content: Boss Ted, everything's ready.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Good. This is the head of the Sinner Bureau, ${PlayerName}. We'll be counting on him to take down SALVA.
steps.female_content: Good. This is the head of the Sinner Bureau, Ms. ${PlayerName}. We'll be counting on her to take down SALVA.

steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content: Chief? Hehe, welcome. And who are these two pretty gals behind you?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: They are Sinners.
The stronghold instantly fell into silence. All eyes in the place shot this way with hostility and fear.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Don't worry. They can't disobey the Chief's order. ${PlayerName} isn't anyone ordinary.

steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content: Really? Then aren't these monsters just like dogs on chains? Hahaha, they deserve this!!! Well done, Chief!
Hecate is apathetic, but Hella is clearly hurt. She glares back at them and at you.
This isn't going well. You give Ted a look. He nods knowingly and follows you outside the stronghold to somewhere secluded.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Chief, my men are rough guys. I apologize if they've offended you.
Ever since seeing the controlling power of the shackles, Ted has become very respectful of you, but this doesn't make you happy.
It's not me but my Sinners they offended.|Get your men to treat them with respect.
options: It's not me but my Sinners they offended.
Get your men to treat them with respect.

steps.content: It's a top-down effect. Ted's humiliation of the Sinners has encouraged the men to follow suit. Ted himself must stop this behavior in order to rectify this situation.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Chief... A few of my men had lost their minds, turned into monsters, and died in this riot. The rest of them doesn't know what they will become tomorrow.
My Sinners didn't cause this

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...I can put up with it for your sake, but I can't control what my men think. I don't have the <color=#fb9259>shackles</color> that you have.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: But why should you consider their feelings? They are just your tools, and you are their master.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Think about it—your power, the shackles, is so strong that even those monsters have no choice but to kneel at your feet and listen to your orders. Do you know how much I respect you?
He gets more excited and heartfelt as he talks, but this doesn't make you happy. On the contrary, it even gives you a sense of suffocation.
At this point, the sound of quarreling comes from inside the stronghold.

steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content: You're nothing but a dog. You *** monsters ***. One day I'll *** ***Mmm!!!
Hella forces the gangster down with her knees and punches him in the nose. Two other gangsters are lying next to her eyes rolled back.
Another gangster stabs her from behind. The girl's shirt rips, and blood soon seeps out from her back. She tumbles but quickly holds her wobbling body up as she turns her fierce face around.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, you want to join in too? Come on. Let me take all of you!
Hella locks eyes with you, then she freezes for a brief moment before she soon returns to her fierce self, if not even more furious. She slaps away the hand you reach out to check her wounds.

steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content:
Wow, you're disobeying the Chief?! That's it!
Come on! Use the shackles to teach her a hard lesson!!!
You take a deep breath.
Hecate, who started it?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: As soon as you left, these guys started to provoke us. This man on the ground hit Hella with a stick first.
She's as indifferent as always, but you and Ted both know Hecate would never lie to you.
Looks like it's not our problem then, Ted.
options: Looks like it's not our problem then, Ted.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}, you...

steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content: You *** ***! I knew you *** *** are up to no good with those *** ***! *** full of lies!!! If you don't discipline your dog, we will!

You smile at the agitated gangsters and help Hella up.
This time, she doesn't slap your hand away but accepts it, dumbfounded.
Has the wound on your back recovered yet?
options: Has the wound on your back recovered yet?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Soon. Hmph, these kinds of thugs can't hurt me.
Good. Want to take revenge?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What!?!! Yes!!
You all turn to the gangsters around you. Since conflicts will happen sooner or later and Ted won't discipline his men, you have no choice but to discipline his dogs for him.
